desc: Ideation: T-constraints deterministic, F-windows need at least one breaker, bump-latest-free-position greedy
Implement solution: forced array + conflict check + 'a' fill + per-F-window bump + final verify (O(n·m) ≈ 5·10⁶, acceptable)

Fix sole-breaker conflict bug: track per-F-window breaker counts; when bumping p for window i, pick smallest char avoiding str2[p-i] and str2[p-j] for any earlier window j solely reliant on p; update counts for all windows containing p; remove dead code

Test against the 3 examples plus edge cases: all-T consistent/inconsistent, single F with m=1, F-window fully forced by T's (impossible), overlapping F-windows sharing one free position, str2 all 'a's, sole-breaker conflict scenario; brute-force cross-check on small random inputs to validate greedy lexicographic minimality
